# SNMP (`snmp`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [Application protocols](../../protocols/app.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 161 (0x00a1) |
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 162 (0x00a2) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `msg_tag` | `uint(8)` | `48` |   | BER tag octet (0x30 SEQUENCE, 0x02 INTEGER, 0x04 OCTET STRING). |
| `msg_length` | `uint(8)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets (`-2`) | BER length of the SNMP message SEQUENCE (Auto; short form, below 128). |
| `version_tag` | `uint(8)` | `2` |   | BER tag octet (0x30 SEQUENCE, 0x02 INTEGER, 0x04 OCTET STRING). |
| `version_length` | `uint(8)` | `1` |   | BER length of the version INTEGER (1). |
| `version` | `enum(8)` | `1` (v2c) |   | SNMP version (0 = v1, 1 = v2c). |
| `community_tag` | `uint(8)` | `4` |   | BER tag octet (0x30 SEQUENCE, 0x02 INTEGER, 0x04 OCTET STRING). |
| `community_length` | `uint(8)` | `6` |   | BER length of the community string, in octets. |
| `community` | `bytes` — `community_length` octets | `70 75 62 6c 69 63` |   | Community string (e.g. "public"). |

### `version`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `v1` |
| 1 (0x01) | `v2c` |
